items.title: Tim Ries interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 19, 2022
items.q: they keep, luckily knock on wood they’ve had me back all these years and so it’s been great to have this gig for so long

ctx.x: Anything that would surprise us about Mick and Keith Richards?

You know it’s like well luckily I’ve known them now for 23 years so it’s like as I said, they’re really prepared, I mean you know Keith has a guitar in his hand all the time and they’re always like working on stuff, new songs, they’re constantly writing, so and he’s reading books you know, Ronnie Wood — he’s like a great artist and he’s painting all the time. Charlie Watts who was a huge jazz fan you know, he actually also was an artist and so he has these beautiful sketches that whenever he got to a hotel when…
When one of the tours ends do you speculate on will they do this again? They keep doing it again, don’t they?
